newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreign sales not cause of Tokyo stock fall -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Foreign sales not cause of Tokyo stock fall -- MOF.

text.p: Falls in Tokyo cash stock prices in recent sessions were due to selling by Japanese, not foreign investors, Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, told a parliamentary committee on Monday.

Sakakibara said foreign investors were net buyers of Japanese cash stocks during the fall of the key Nikkei stock index earlier this month, and added it was the dealing accounts of Japanese securities houses that were the sellers.
"As for cash stocks, it was Japanese (stock) selling by Japanese investors, not by foreigners," he said.

Sakakibara also said the rise of the Japan premium -- the extra cost Japanese banks are charged when raising funds in the Euro interbank market -- was not due to selling of Japanese stocks by foreigners.
